semanticBoundary.acceptedUnits: Top-level script_unit count plus structural parse-tree SHA-256.
semanticBoundary.declarations: Not extracted by this laboratory; identical parse trees bound the semantic consumer input.
semanticBoundary.references: Not extracted by this laboratory; external qualification remains required.
semanticBoundary.dependencies: Not extracted by this laboratory; external qualification remains required.
semanticBoundary.diagnostics: Counts plus a SHA-256 over the ordered lexer and final parser diagnostics; message text is never published.
semanticBoundary.recovery: Final parse tree, unit count, and diagnostic sequence must match.

classification.intended: Only the declared field transition, with parse trees, units, tokens, and diagnostics unchanged.
classification.unsupported: Explicitly allowlisted files that both states reject; requires external classification.
classification.defect: Any other difference; the gate fails.

runtimeBoundary.typescript: Semantic-conformance gated for issues #1–#3, #18, and the combined final state.
runtimeBoundary.java: The official grammar produces 367 parser diagnostics on the frozen production corpus; cross-runtime tree conformance remains required before Java is eligible as a replacement.
